entries.2357b9fbc78f22f1: It states its management philosophy as “to pursue material and spiritual prosperity together with all stakeholders through the excellent products and services we create,” and says it aims for sustainable growth and enhancement of corporate value by providing optimal living environments that match diverse customer needs, including the sale of high-quality, price-competitive ready-built houses, sale of investment properties for wealthy individuals, and construction contracts for mid-to-high-end custom-built homes.
entries.24a2db9d95169c7b: Affluent individuals and corporations seeking investment real estate
entries.25d7dfa5bd8398da: A reportable segment in which consolidated subsidiary Morizō Co.,Ltd. undertakes the design and construction of custom-built homes for customers. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥1,377 million. It builds mid-to-high-end custom-built homes using domestically produced fine timber “Kiso hinoki”, mainly in the Kanto-Koshinetsu area.
entries.2a195335ccfdc3bb: It plans, develops and sells ready-built houses in regional core cities and suburbs of the Tokyo metropolitan area, and sells investment properties such as the investment condominium “Lesco” and the investment wooden apartment “Atelese” by whole building.
entries.390e470ff05f4fee: This is a business model that earns income from selling ready-built houses and investment properties, and from construction contracts for mid-to-high-end custom-built homes using Kiso hinoki.
entries.3df0b4e15996c74a: “Good homes that first-time buyers working diligently in regional cities or suburbs of the Tokyo metropolitan area can afford without strain.” Built-for-sale homes are planned and developed mainly in regional core cities and suburbs of the Tokyo metropolitan area.
entries.4d81a00a773c9004: Based on the description of business.
entries.4fa780d277cf87c8: A company engaged in real estate sales, such as ready-built houses and investment condominiums, and in construction contracting for custom-built houses using domestic hinoki cypress.
entries.4fb851b9b855254c: Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥3,416 million.
entries.562708c5efd0a196: Revenue from sales of ready-built houses
entries.5c6f3632f7622d79: Customers for ready-built houses are first-time homebuyers working in regional cities and suburbs of the Tokyo metropolitan area; customers for investment properties are wealthy individuals and corporations; and customers for construction contracts are individuals building custom-built homes.
entries.613863860910e741: Revenue from sales of investment properties
entries.6466db2045f12636: A business that plans, develops and supplies, by whole building, the investment condominium “Lesco” series, the investment wooden apartment “Aterēze” series and simple lodging facilities (minpaku buildings), and a business that buys and sells used real estate such as tenant buildings. Revenue for each category alone is not disclosed.
entries.6540c257194f4ddb: In the housing and condominium industry, against a backdrop of persistently high real estate prices accompanying rising construction costs and rising interest rates, purchasing intentions among end-users have remained cautious. On the other hand, excessive competition among companies is largely being left behind, and smaller operators withdrawing from the ready-built house business in regional areas have also been observed; the company views the market environment as entering a turning point.
entries.67fa1a40424ab7fb: In the fiscal year ended December 2025, the number of ready-built houses sold and their unit prices rose, but sales of investment properties, such as large rental condominiums, were weak; in the construction contract business, the lengthening of confirmation approvals due to a legal revision delayed the start of construction on orders, and revenue declined from the prior year. Meanwhile, it made Sanai Home Co., Ltd. a subsidiary in January 2025, thereby adding to its real estate sales business, and at Morizo Co., Ltd., it has narrowed its loss through improvements in cost structure from consolidating showrooms and reviewing its personnel structure.
entries.6972db170410f986: Based on the description of management policy, business environment and issues to be addressed, and the analysis by management of financial position, operating results and cash flows.
entries.710f48c6eb69a7b1: Ready-built houses, investment properties and custom-built homes
entries.74127c6f457600dd: Custom-built homes using domestic premium wood “Kiso hinoki”
entries.7e7107af67a9d12e: Its ready-built houses are characterized by being buildable on small or irregularly shaped plots and by being priced within a range that first-time homebuyers can afford comfortably. The investment condominium “Lesco” offers quality comparable to condominiums for sale at a price that makes it easy for wealthy individuals to acquire as income-producing property, and the investment wooden apartment “Atelese” has as its strengths planning suited to each location and control of construction costs through wood construction. In construction contracts, it specializes in mid-to-high-end custom-built homes using domestic premium wood “Kiso hinoki”.
entries.82ce59cca6280424: Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥3,416 million, down 19.2% from ¥4,226 million in the prior year. The real estate sales business was ¥2,038 million and the construction contract business was ¥1,377 million. The decrease was due to weak sales of investment properties and delayed commencement of construction on orders in the construction contract business.
entries.85cdce5c137cdda0: It states its management philosophy as “to pursue material and spiritual prosperity together with all stakeholders through the excellent products and services we create,” and says it aims for sustainable growth and enhancement of corporate value by providing optimal living environments that match diverse customer needs, including the sale of high-quality, price-competitive ready-built houses, sale of investment properties for wealthy individuals, and construction contracts for mid-to-high-end custom-built homes. It has set its slogan for the fiscal year ending December 2026 as “Totonoeru”, and identifies the development of its earnings base and personnel structure as important management issues. For ready-built houses, it aims to secure stable earnings while maintaining the current business scale; for investment properties, it aims to increase its owned properties and build up rental income; and for its consolidated subsidiary Morizo Co., Ltd., it aims for an early return to profitability and a shift to a phase of investment recovery.
entries.885ffa908dcc5f9c: For the fiscal year ended December 2025, it recorded a net loss attributable to owners of the parent of ¥3 million.

entries.9110b51202a57153: For the fiscal year ended December 2025, it recorded a net loss attributable to owners of the parent of ¥3 million. entries.a97ac9f5fb290ebc: A reportable segment that sells built-for-sale homes and investment real estate. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥2,038 million. Built-for-sale homes are planned and developed mainly in regional core cities and suburbs of the Tokyo metropolitan area. For investment real estate, the company sells investment condominiums, investment wooden apartment buildings and simple lodging facilities by whole building, and also buys and sells used real estate. Sanai Home Co.,Ltd., which became a subsidiary on January 6, 2025, also conducts business in this segment.
